scope: Desktop Chromium WebGL2 with SwiftShader software rasterization; no Android phone GPU or vehicle testing.
checks: Loads unchanged detailed Highland geometry in actual WebGL2.
All manual qualities change raster/shadow resolution while preserving exact frames, fades, RGB, closure states, every emitter and estimated-mapping flags.
Quality preference persists and invalid modes fail explicitly.
Paused, settled preview does not continually redraw.
Forty sequence updates perform no snapshot projections until requested; the requested snapshot uses the latest exported frame.
IntersectionObserver stops all offscreen drawing and resumes at the newest sequence frame.
Zero-size/hidden canvases do not submit graphics work.
Backward seeking restores deterministic geometry, fade/RGB values and frame across quality changes.
Synthetic sustained timing samples verify adaptive downgrade, slower recovery hysteresis, and no override of explicit quality.
Reports observed continuous rendering intervals and CPU submission time with explicit software-renderer scope.
Rear and cabin cutaway cameras remain functional after adaptive quality changes.
Actual graphics-context loss pauses and restores current quality, bloom and drawing.
Disposal disconnects observers and stops scheduling further frames.
